### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>klauspost/compress (github.com/klauspost/compress)</summary>

### [`v1.20.5`](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/releases/tag/v1.20.5)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/compare/v1.20.4...v1.20.5)

#### What's Changed

- flate: count the whole window for the level 9 literal cost estimate by [@​yxshee](https://redirect.github.com/yxshee) in [#​1306](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1306)
- gzhttp: return buffered write errors from FlushError by [@​yxshee](https://redirect.github.com/yxshee) in [#​1310](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1310)
- xpress: reject a Huffman match that runs past the declared size by [@​yxshee](https://redirect.github.com/yxshee) in [#​1309](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1309)
- flate: keep the reader failed after WriteTo short write by [@​CJstate](https://redirect.github.com/CJstate) in [#​1304](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1304)
- s2: omit empty indexes and check stream bounds by [@​yxshee](https://redirect.github.com/yxshee) in [#​1311](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1311)
- gzip: mark reader ended after WriteTo of a single stream by [@​CJstate](https://redirect.github.com/CJstate) in [#​1302](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1302)
- gzhttp: preserve status selected by buffered writes by [@​hakarrr](https://redirect.github.com/hakarrr) in [#​1318](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1318)
- zip: honor zipinsecurepath set by //go:debug or go.mod godebug by [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) in [#​1319](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1319)
- gzip: report short writes of the CRC/ISIZE footer from Close by [@​CJstate](https://redirect.github.com/CJstate) in [#​1316](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1316)
- zstd: state that encoder output is only stable within one version by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1314](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1314)
- zstd: faster and smaller small frames with dictionaries by [@​spotdemo4](https://redirect.github.com/spotdemo4) in [#​1280](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1280)
- s2, zstd: consume bytes.Buffer input in ReadFrom and Decoder.Reset by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​1320](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1320)
- s2: report truncated skippable chunks read by a callback by [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) in [#​1326](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1326)
- flate: fix inflate checkpoints after stored blocks and at the final block by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​1327](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1327)
- s2/cmd: Harden CLI output creation and self-extractor tar extraction by [@​deepnemesis](https://redirect.github.com/deepnemesis) in [#​1297](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1297)
- s2: report ErrCorrupt when skippable callback returns io.EOF on truncated stream ([#​1330](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/issues/1330)) by [@​Yshuro](https://redirect.github.com/Yshuro) in [#​1331](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1331)
- gzhttp: do not compress 206 responses without Content-Range, read Accept-Encoding across field lines by [@​waw666waw666](https://redirect.github.com/waw666waw666) in [#​1332](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1332)
- s2: clear stream type when resetting Reader by [@​anishpentyala](https://redirect.github.com/anishpentyala) in [#​1324](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1324)
- s2c: return failure for stdin-to-stdout stream errors by [@​perfloop-agent](https://redirect.github.com/perfloop-agent) in [#​1328](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1328)
- flate: clear the decoding table for an empty Huffman code by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​1334](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1334)
- zstd: don't return stale output when sequence execution fails by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​1335](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1335)
- flate: reject a checkpoint BitOffset above 7 by [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) in [#​1325](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1325)

#### New Contributors

- [@​hakarrr](https://redirect.github.com/hakarrr) made their first contribution in [#​1318](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1318)
- [@​spotdemo4](https://redirect.github.com/spotdemo4) made their first contribution in [#​1280](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1280)
- [@​deepnemesis](https://redirect.github.com/deepnemesis) made their first contribution in [#​1297](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1297)
- [@​Yshuro](https://redirect.github.com/Yshuro) made their first contribution in [#​1331](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1331)
- [@​waw666waw666](https://redirect.github.com/waw666waw666) made their first contribution in [#​1332](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1332)
- [@​anishpentyala](https://redirect.github.com/anishpentyala) made their first contribution in [#​1324](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1324)
- [@​perfloop-agent](https://redirect.github.com/perfloop-agent) made their first contribution in [#​1328](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1328)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/klauspost/compress/compare/v1.20.4...v1.20.5>

</details>
